stem.text: Which statement about the structure of the heart is correct?

A.text: The semilunar valves close when the pressure in the ventricles falls lower than the pressure in the arteries.

B.text: A muscle called the septum separates the atria from the ventricles.

C.text: There is a small patch of tissue in the right atrium that acts to delay the electrical impulse.

D.text: Closure of valves in the veins prevents backflow of blood into the ventricles.
